learning_reward_architecture.local_reward: own power / installed capacity - own weighted relative service deficits - guaranteed_output_violation_weight * own guaranteed-output violation indicator; all service costs are disabled when reward penalties are disabled
learning_reward_architecture.critic: one centralized scalar value for the shared team return
learning_reward_architecture.actor_advantages: actor-specific frozen one-step system-Q minus its old-policy counterfactual baseline; common RMS scaling
learning_reward_architecture.actor_objective_reduction: mean over all rollout rows; policy active masks zero forced rows
learning_reward_architecture.actor_discount_scope: gamma remains in GAE, Monte Carlo returns and reward accounting; no additional gamma**t multiplier on policy or entropy objectives
learning_reward_architecture.legacy_metrics: existing reward, CSV metrics and plot curves retain their team-reward definitions
learning_reward_architecture.update_interpretation: model-assisted HAPPO surrogate with actor-specific counterfactual credit and sequential likelihood factors

training_window_sampling.coverage_scope: completed training episodes only; evaluation and partial failed batches excluded

seed_plans.objective: minimize squared error from equal simulated training-day fractions per source year
seed_plans.forcing_used_for_planning: source dates only; no inflows, rewards, policies or evaluation outcomes
seed_plans.sampling_rule: precomputed integer quotas and seeded duplicate-free batches

planner.algorithm: bounded-simplex accelerated projected gradient; integer rounding and improving exchanges

seed_plans.limitation: Residual year imbalance can be unavoidable under complete consecutive episodes and held-out isolation; balancing calendar-year exposure does not stratify wet/normal/dry hydrological classes.

periodic_evaluation.schedule: round 0, every eval_interval completed updates, and the final update
periodic_evaluation.action_selection: deterministic argmax; fresh environments; no training samples
periodic_evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three complete windows; null metrics if any window fails
periodic_evaluation.violation_rate_definition: violating active reservoir-days / all active reservoir-days; counts pooled over all three complete windows; undiscounted; null if a window fails or no requirement is active
periodic_evaluation.role: fixed training-only convergence diagnostics; held-out years are reserved for final evaluation

trajectory_diagnostics.scope: collected training trajectories only; one row per day, environment lane and reservoir
trajectory_diagnostics.values: frozen before optimization and before ValueNorm statistics change
trajectory_diagnostics.advantages: frozen one-step counterfactual raw/normalized actor credit; critic GAE fields remain separate
trajectory_diagnostics.episode_time_weight: always 1.0; column retained for CSV compatibility
trajectory_diagnostics.policy_objective_weight: policy active mask only; HAPPO likelihood factor is recorded separately
trajectory_diagnostics.monte_carlo: realized sampled reward-to-go, not true expected values or true advantages
trajectory_diagnostics.updates: observational only; no reward, action, optimizer or normalization changes

policy_checkpoints.schedule: final completed update and every N updates if interval is positive
policy_checkpoints.purpose: deterministic evaluation replay; training resume is not implemented

xld_dispatch_diagnostics.scope: every XLD day in the final scheduled periodic evaluation and final held-out evaluation only
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.counterfactual: same current state and action-date bounds; all other reservoir actions held fixed
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.interpretation: same-day physical attainability; no future inflows, action replacement or claim of long-term optimality
xld_dispatch_diagnostics.data_precision: 10 significant digits in CSV; internal calculations and JSON summaries retain full precision

calendar: fixed consecutive daily steps with leap days retained; storage carries across source-year boundaries
daily_bound_alignment: action_date=t constrains the state after action t; no additional date shift

step_logging.record_scope: one row per environment day; scalar team metrics over all five reservoirs
step_logging.daily_reward_discounting: undiscounted; apply gamma**(episode_step-1) for episode totals
step_logging.shortfall_aggregation: physical deficits are summed over the five reservoirs; penalties retain reward weights and means
step_logging.missing_service_values: empty CSV cells; known zero deficits are written as 0
step_logging.float_precision: 10 significant digits in CSV only; internal calculations retain full precision
step_logging.output: one CSV per seed; JSONL contains summaries and configuration

evaluation: held-out representative years in configured order; storage carries across boundaries; one sequence scored after training, without policy ranking

counterfactual_credit.advantage: selected Q minus old-policy probability-weighted Q over all own commands; other original commands fixed
counterfactual_credit.normalization: one common RMS over controllable actor rows; no centering
counterfactual_credit.role: model-assisted HAPPO variant; no monotonic-improvement or physical optimality claim

batch.diversity_definition: inverse concentration of sampled-window frequencies; not statistical sample size

critic_bootstrap: frozen rollout critic and ValueNorm; zero at terminal and when gamma is zero
scope: same starting state and other original commands; all downstream physics and team rewards recomputed
limitation: approximate one-step action values; long-term performance improvement is not established

actor_objective_reduction: mean over all rollout rows; policy active masks zero forced rows
episode_time_weight: always 1.0; column retained for CSV compatibility
policy_objective_weight: policy active mask only; HAPPO likelihood factor is recorded separately
value_source: before_update snapshot in reward units before optimization and ValueNorm changes
own_column_interpretation: actor-associated learning target; shared_team rows repeat one common team value and return
probability_source: before_update collection distribution; forced effective probability/log-probability are 1/0 placeholders
interpretation: observational correlated training rows; realized reward-to-go is not expected value; spill and advantage association does not establish avoidability or causation

learning_signal.actor_objective_reduction: mean over all rollout rows; configured active masks zero excluded rows
learning_signal.interpretation: realized Monte Carlo targets and rowwise spread on the collected training trajectories; not true advantages, independent daily samples, or held-out critic accuracy

batch.diversity_definition: inverse concentration of sampled-window frequencies; not statistical sample size

evaluator_return_aggregation: sum(gamma**t * daily_reward), t=0 at episode start
scenario_aggregation: arithmetic mean over all three fixed windows; null when any window fails
violation_rate_definition: violating active reservoir-days / all active reservoir-days; undiscounted and independent of reward weights and shortfall magnitudes
violation_rate_aggregation: sum counts / sum active reservoir-days across all three complete windows; null when any window fails or the denominator is zero
